hook.name: Sa1tHookV2
hook.description: A bonding-curve launchpad hook serving every SA1T token pool through three phases: CURVE (custom constant-product AMM via ERC-6909 claims, fully NoOp'd against the pool), REFUND_WINDOW (optional money-back sells at average entry price), and AMM (full-range liquidity locked in LPLocker with TWAP oracle). Applies a 1.5% fee split between protocol and creator, plus an optional mechanic fee, on both buys and sells across all phases.
